headline: Revenue and margins keep climbing to close the year
summary_short: ADP's fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue rose 7% y/y to $5.47B and diluted EPS grew 10% y/y to $2.45, as adjusted EBIT margin expanded 140bps to 25.1%; full-year diluted EPS reached $10.94 (+10% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue rose 7% y/y to $5.47B, split between Employer Services (+7% reported, +6% organic) and PEO Services (+7%); ES bookings reached $2.2B for the year with retention flat at 92.1%. Net earnings rose 7% to $978.6M; adjusted net earnings rose 14% to $1.05B. Adjusted EBIT grew 13% to $1.37B and margin expanded 140bps to 25.1%, aided by a 15% rise in client-funds interest to $355M, partly offset by a $91.1M business-alignment charge and a 100bps PEO margin decline. Diluted EPS rose 10% to $2.45; adjusted diluted EPS rose 17% to $2.64. ADP initiated fiscal 2027 guidance: 5-6% revenue growth, 70-90bps EBIT-margin expansion, 9-11% adjusted EPS growth.

drivers.explanation: Employer Services revenue rose 7% reported (6% organic constant currency) and PEO Services rose 7%, supported by $2.2B of ES new-business bookings and flat 92.1% client retention for the year.

Margin expansion was driven by a 15% rise in interest on funds held for clients to $355M and 90bps of Employer Services margin gain, partly offset by a 100bps PEO Services margin decline and a $91.1M business-alignment charge.

GAAP diluted EPS growth of 10% y/y trailed adjusted EPS growth of 17%, with the gap explained by a $91.1M business-alignment charge, partially offset by an $8M ADP Ventures gain and a $5M optimization-initiative reversal disclosed in the non-GAAP reconciliation.

Management said the quarter finished at the high end of its guidance range for revenue growth, margin expansion, and adjusted EPS growth, and initiated fiscal 2027 guidance for continued mid-single-digit revenue growth and margin expansion.
